name: reborrow_shared
documentation:
Borrows a new shared reference from the unique borrow initially captured.

 # Safety

 The reborrow must have ended, i.e., the reference returned by `new` and
 all pointers and references derived from it, must not be used anymore.
rules: For safety when calling `reborrow_shared`, the reborrow must have ended: the reference returned by `new` and all pointers and references derived from it must not be used anymore.
